name: ai-for-boss
description: AI for Boss desktop product shell, built on OpenClaw.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm run contracts:generate && corepack pnpm --filter @aifb/desktop build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm --filter @aifb/desktop start
scripts.package:desktop: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run test && corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run validate:desktop
